description: You use associative containers to organize values by keys. These examples contrast sorted keys with a hash table.

steps.description: word_count maps words to counts. Incrementing each key counts occurrences, and the later loop visits keys in sorted order.
unordered_map uses a hash table. The code reserves buckets, sets a load-factor limit, and stores two values.
set holds sorted unique keys. The example inserts a key and checks whether another key is present.
lower_bound locates the first key at least 5. upper_bound locates the first key greater than 11, which marks the loop's stopping position.

title: Compare key-based containers
